top_violation_types.title: Liability Insurance Requirements -  Have Coverage of at Least $300,000 For Each Occurrence of Negligence (26 TAC §742.403((1)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation has not responded to multiple attempts regarding liability insurance.

top_violation_types.title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not conduct a fire drill for the month of August.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One child's file was missing a health statement.

top_violation_types.title: AP Parental Communication - Injury Requires Treatment by Health Care Professional or Hospitalization (26 TAC §746.307(b)(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Staff did not notify the parents of a child who received an injury while in care.

top_violation_types.title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(5)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The staff files reviewed did not have the required Health and Safety training topic certificates for the last full year of training.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §746.4135(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: CPSC form was not available for review.

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The promotion of Physical Activity was not available for review in the Operational Policies.

top_violation_types.title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment - Crib for Each Non-walking Infant Younger Than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §746.2405(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: No cribs were observed in the infant room.
